title: Founding & Seed Capital
description: SZL Holdings incorporated in Washington, D.C. with $2.4M in seed funding from angel investors and a founding team of four engineers and operators. Initial thesis: build vertically-integrated governed decision infrastructure for industries with fragmented, legacy software — where signal, recommendation, policy, and proof have to live in one accountable layer.

title: Vessels MVP & First Revenue
description: Launched the Vessels maritime intelligence MVP, securing three pilot contracts with mid-size shipping operators in Southeast Asia. First revenue: $18K MRR within 90 days of launch.

title: Series A Financing
description: Closed $14.5M Series A led by a consortium of institutional investors, valuing SZL at $62M pre-money. Funding earmarked for engineering headcount, cloud infrastructure, and the launch of two new portfolio companies.

title: Aegis & Alloy Creative Engine Launch
description: Simultaneously launched Aegis cybersecurity and defense intelligence platform (securing a DoD subcontractor pilot) and the Alloy Creative Engine for campaign production and brand workflows. Team expanded to 45 engineers across three time zones.

title: Government & Enterprise Traction
description: Aegis selected for a U.S. defense contractor evaluation program. Vessels surpassed 25,000 tracked vessels and expanded to European shipping lanes. Total portfolio ARR crossed $8M.

title: London Operations Hub
description: Opened London office to serve European maritime and financial services clients. Hired VP of Engineering (ex-Palantir) and VP of Sales (ex-CrowdStrike). Headcount reached 82.

title: Lyte AI Command Center (Beta)
description: Launched Lyte — the internal MLOps layer powering AI across all portfolio companies. Unified model training, deployment, and monitoring. Processing 18M+ daily inference requests within six months.

title: Singapore Office & APAC Growth
description: Established Singapore presence to accelerate maritime intelligence adoption across Asia-Pacific. Signed enterprise contracts with two of the world's top 20 container shipping lines. Portfolio ARR surpassed $20M.

title: Ecosystem Convergence
description: Achieved full cross-platform data integration: unified authentication, shared threat intelligence between Aegis and Vessels, and AI model portability via Lyte. The ecosystem thesis becomes operational reality.

title: INCA & Carlota Jo Enter Alpha
description: Two new portfolio companies entered private alpha: INCA (AI-native consulting analytics) and Carlota Jo (brand intelligence platform). Combined 20 pilot clients signed before public launch.

title: Series B & Global Scale
description: Targeting $45M Series B to fund international expansion, accelerate INCA and Carlota Jo to general availability, and triple Aegis's defense sector presence. Portfolio ARR exceeding $35M with a path to profitability.
